about: Zips as src/zip.mjs createZip writes them: world exports where the tar cannot write zip (GNU tar, so Linux), the file browser's zip action and the diagnostics bundle. test/contracts-files.test.mjs zips the tree below and reads the central directory back byte by byte.

rules.order: members in the order given; inside each, depth first, a folder before its contents, names in plain code-unit order (Array.prototype.sort, not localeCompare: B < Zed < _x < a), folders and files mixed. Links, sockets and devices are skipped.
rules.names: relative paths with /, folders ending in /, UTF-8, general purpose flag 0x0800 (UTF-8 names) on every entry, no data descriptors (each local header is patched after its data).
rules.method: 0 (stored) for folders and empty files, 8 (deflate, zlib raw) for everything else
rules.versions: made by 0x032d (Unix, 4.5); needed 20, or 45 with zip64 fields, which are written only when a size or offset passes 32 bits (or a file is within 64 KiB of 4 GiB)
rules.attributes: external attributes: (st_mode & 0xffff) << 16, | 0x10 for a folder. Node gives Windows files S_IFREG and folders S_IFDIR too.
rules.time: DOS date and time from the file's mtime in LOCAL time, years clamped to 1980..2107

exclude: world exports pass exclude ['session.lock'] (EXCLUDE_ARGS without --exclude): a basename skipped anywhere
